where: Driftholm after the isles' dawn: the fog lifted, boats out, the town awake in daylight
mood: The same island hymn turned major and full: a town that has its morning back.
_motif_note: Conditioned high on the isles' own motif (motif-farlamp.json): the same hymn as driftholm, turned major. 84 BPM = the anchor's grid.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
a warm pulse-wave lead singing the seafaring hymn tune in a major key
glass bells and celesta answering every phrase
gentle festive drums with soft snare and tambourine
joyful, warm and grateful, a harbour town in morning sunlight

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a bright bell call and a harp run open straight onto D major, the drums tapping in on the last bar}
styles: a bold call over a pickup

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the hymn tune sung out in D major on the warm lead, full string chords and rolling harp beneath}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the hymn again, fuller, the bells singing a counter-line and the flute weaving under it, gentle festive drums}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a tender turn to B minor and G major, the melody lower and grateful, remembering the long dark, then lifting on an A major chord}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the hymn returns in full radiant D major; the last bar leads straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
